<title>NeuralForge AI to Be Acquired by Calderon Systems in $480M All-Stock Transaction</title>
<link>https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/10/28/NeuralForge-AI-to-Be-Acquired-by-Calderon-Systems.html</link>

<pubDate>Wed, 28 Oct 2026 15:12:00 GMT</pubDate>
<description><![CDATA[Calderon Systems today announced it has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire NeuralForge AI, the machine learning platform for semiconductor yield optimization, in an all-stock transaction valued at approximately $480 million.]]></description>
